# LeeAttend

LeeAttend is a high-performance attendance management system with a Rust core and React dashboard.

## Core Documentation
- [PROJECT_OS.md](file:///home/elt1541/lee/leeattend/PROJECT_OS.md): Mandatory technical protocols, build/test commands, and Definition of Done. **Read this first.**
- [README.md](file:///home/elt1541/lee/leeattend/README.md): High-level architecture and project overview.

## Guides
- [Docker Workflow](file:///home/elt1541/lee/leeattend/docs/docker-workflow.md): Detailed explanation of layered compose files and multi-stage builds.
- [Deployment Guide](file:///home/elt1541/lee/leeattend/docs/deployment-guide.md): Production setup and infrastructure requirements.
